blockingFindings.title: Unsafe files rejection is masked by invalid id rejection
blockingFindings.issue: The single R4 case for invalid plugin ids and invalid files patterns uses both an invalid package id and an invalid files entry in the same fixture. An implementation that rejects only the id and never validates unsafe files patterns would still pass this test, leaving the invalid files requirement without independent executable coverage.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Split this into separate cases: one fixture with an invalid id and otherwise safe files, and one fixture with a valid id and an unsafe files pattern such as '../outside'.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 explicitly requires rejecting invalid ids and invalid files; the current test has a static anti-pattern that can pass without exercising production validation for invalid files.
